name: Jasper-Meridian

civilization.name: The Jasperine Collective
civilization.notes: A decentralized society of artisan-builders who construct elaborate stone cities using mineral pigments as a form of written language.

description: Jasper-Meridian is a world of banded stone and warm earth tones, its surface striped in reds, ochres, and burnt sienna like the mineral for which it is named. Enormous canyon systems reveal cross-sections of geological history billions of years deep, their layered walls glowing amber in the afternoon light. Geothermal vents along the canyon floors exhale plumes of mineral-laden steam that drift upward in slow spirals.

Standing on the canyon rim, one hears the low thrum of the planet's exposed core resonating through the bedrock, a deep vibration felt more in the chest than the ears. The air is dry and warm, carrying the faint sulfurous tang of the vents. Nights bring a stunning display of atmospheric refraction, bending starlight into ribbons of color across the sky.

The Jasperine Collective has thrived here for millennia, building their tiered cities directly into the canyon walls. Their written language, painted in mineral pigments, adorns every surface and is said to encode not just words but emotional states. Predating even their oldest settlements, however, are the monolithic black pillars found at precise intervals along the planet's equator, made from a material the Collective cannot replicate.

Contact protocols restrict off-world interference, but the Collective's iron-age technology cannot explain the monoliths, and the question of who placed them draws covert interest from multiple factions. Smugglers have begun trading in Jasperine pigment-texts, which fetch extraordinary prices as art objects. The Collective remains unaware of the wider galaxy, but that innocence is unlikely to last.
